PLD 2016 Lahore 539
IN THE HIGH COURT OF LAHORE AT LAHORE
Before Syed Mansoor Ali Shah, J
Civil Revision No. 120 of 2015
Khan Enterprises versus Province of Punjab
The record shows that the petitioner filed the revision against an interlocutory order. During arguments the learned counsel for the petitioner contended that the trial court failed to appreciate that the respondent had not produced the original agreement. The petitioner further argued that the impugned order would cause irreparable loss because the machinery installed at the site could not be removed without formal permission. These contentions require examination of the entire evidence led by the parties.
JUDGMENT
SYED MANSOOR ALI SHAH, J. We have heard the learned counsel for the parties at length. The revision is admitted to consider whether the trial court applied the correct test while granting interim relief. Let notice issue to the respondent for a date in office. CR.A-539/L Notice
